page.overview:
What is MTV: Icon Medley?

MTV: Icon Medley (also known as Career Spanning Medley) is a medley song by Metallica. The medley is a combination of songs from the first 5 albums.

The band was selected by MTV to be part of their third annual ICON tribute show, to celebrate their achievements. The show ended with the band playing a medley of songs from the first 5 albums and then followed by a performance of the song "Frantic".

No life 'til leather We're gonna kick some ass tonight We got the metal madness When our fans start screaming It's right, well alright When we start to rock We never want to stop again

Hit the lights Hit the lights Hit the lights
